name: aviasales-mcp
description: Find the cheapest flight for a route or a budget from Aviasales (Travelpayouts) cached fares. Read-only: the server has no tool that books or pays.

api_token.title: Travelpayouts API token
api_token.description: Your Travelpayouts (Aviasales) data API token. Stored in the system credential store.

market.title: Market
market.description: Two-letter market whose fare cache to read, e.g. ru, us, th. Prices differ by market.
